targetHarness: GitHub Copilot harness in Copilot Studio
topology: One invoice agent; enable tools and optional workflows for the customer's goal
humanReviewPolicy: Unusual or uncertain cases pause dependent automated writes; authorized humans correct, reject or escalate, then required controls revalidate before resume

visibility.value: Faster answers without changing the finance process

end_to_end.value: Less handling from receipt to confirmed finance registration

costPolicy: Read before reprocessing; invoke AI only where useful; cap calls per case; choose optional Azure tools only after a customer-specific total-cost comparison
deploymentNote: Configure in the new Copilot Studio experience; this design JSON is not an import package
